headline: COL @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is COL 5.25 at OAK 5.97, with a projected total of 11.22. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (COL +0.63, OAK +0.59), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +1.22, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -8.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Tomoyuki Sugano has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Shea Langeliers, Troy Johnston, Tyler Soderstrom, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Carlos Cortes, Colby Thomas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
